[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../stdlib/std/host_clocks.lani#L3)

Layer: `std`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Kind checks (wall/steady/CPU), PID bounds and waitability are decided before any host call. Absolute waits use clock_nanosleep(TIMER_ABSTIME) and retry EINTR with the same target. ProcessCpuOf names a child only while it is unreaped. Evidence is finite native Linux x86_64 CPU execution.
